enhanced_information: Infliximab, Adalimumab, Anakinra, and Etanercept are all biologic drugs used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, functioning as TNF-alpha inhibitors or IL-1 receptor antagonists to reduce inflammation. Denosumab, however, is primarily a RANKL inhibitor used to treat osteoporosis and is not indicated for rheumatoid arthritis, aligning with the consensus that it does not directly address the inflammatory processes characteristic of this condition. Therefore, Denosumab is the drug not applicable in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
